title: A due improvement review: what holds it, Review Now writing one, and Open the Latest Improvement Review showing its tab

steps.caption: The last review is 8 days old: the next is due
Due now, and what holds it back: it waits while agents work
Review Now starts one anyway, in a free slot: the view says who's writing it
When it's written, it tops the list
With another editor in front of it…
…Open the Latest Improvement Review shows that same tab: no second one, no Markdown preview
